provenance.proceduralHeight: Seamless direction-vector field, little-endian uint16, height = -120 + sample x 0.5 m; bounded range is recorded per level; synthetic approximation only.

uranus.coordinateConvention: Runtime samples the supplied 2:1 texture with east-positive -180..180 and north-at-top conventions; source longitude alignment and prime meridian are unverified.

coordinates.projection: 2:1 image texture; exact source projection metadata is not published

uranus.heightPolicy: Uranus is an ice giant: no solid terrain or height files are emitted. Atmospheric color and band/brightness appearance are never elevation.

provenance.citation: NASA/JPL/Caltech Solar System Simulator Uranus texture map; JPL identifies it as a fictional plain solid-blue representative texture.
provenance.coverage: Global representative atmospheric appearance; JPL states that Uranus maps are representative, atmospheric dynamics change daily, and textures are not for scientific analysis.
provenance.license: NASA/JPL/Caltech public resource; retain NASA/JPL attribution and fictional/representative qualification.
provenance.processing: Pinned 720x360 JPL JPEG; verified 8-bit sRGB 3-channel metadata; resized without reprojection to 512x256 preview and native-capped 720x360 medium and near JPEG derivatives; color only.
provenance.orientationEvidence: JPL publishes a rendered texture but no cartographic geotransform, prime meridian, longitude sign, or pole-orientation metadata. Pixel order is preserved without flip or rotate; absolute imagery alignment is unverified.

venus.heightPolicy: Measured Magellan altimetry elevations; NoData is encoded as zero only outside measured samples. Height is never inferred from image brightness.

sourceGeoTIFF.projection: Simple Cylindrical centered 0 degrees; planetocentric Venus sphere

provenance.verticalDatum: Venus mean-radius datum; source page describes elevation in meters relative to radius 6051800 m; radius = 6051800 + elevation
provenance.license: USGS Astrogeology / NASA Magellan public-domain product; retain mission and product attribution
provenance.processing: GeoTIFF geotransform and GeoKeys validated; north-up eastward source rows decoded and resampled directly to runtime east-positive -180..180; no eye-balled flip; uint16 height encoding with 0.5 m steps
provenance.coverage: Global map with source NoData gaps; source measured elevation range -2951..11687 m

radar.appearance: Magellan SAR radar backscatter; not visible color, not albedo, not height; black areas are source coverage gaps
radar.license: USGS Astrogeology / NASA Magellan public-domain product
